domain: AI-Powered Corporate Digital Transformation & B2B SaaS

identity.theme: Hybrid (Dark Tech Hero + Light Mode Body)
identity.tone: Ultra-professional, corporate, modern, premium, trustworthy, authoritative

usage_rules.hero_background: deep_space_navy (#07111F) transitioning to pure_white (#FFFFFF) for subsequent sections.
usage_rules.cta_buttons: Linear gradient from roket_blue to electric_cyan. Must include a subtle glow on hover.
usage_rules.cards: pure_white background with very thin border (e.g., border-slate-200) and soft, subtle shadow. Hover lift required.
usage_rules.section_headings: deep_space_navy (#07111F) on light backgrounds, pure_white on dark backgrounds.
usage_rules.accents: rocket_orange (#F97316) used extremely sparingly (e.g., small badges, notification dots, subtle active states).

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous, airy, readable. Optimize for enterprise trust and clarity.

grids.solutions_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 (Bento-inspired but structurally uniform for 12 cards)

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for layouts. Do not use standard Shadcn containers if they restrict fluid/asymmetric designs.
components_strategy.interactive_logic: Heavily customize Shadcn components for forms, tabs, and modals to match the corporate tech aesthetic.
components_strategy.admin_dashboard: Utilize Shadcn components (tables, cards, charts) for data-heavy views. Ensure JWT login logic layout is sleek.
components_strategy.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for premium tech feel.

header.design: Sticky navigation. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07111F]/80 on dark hero, transitioning to bg-white/80 on scroll if technically feasible, or stay consistent dark with white text.
header.elements: Logo, Mega navigation menu, CTA button (Gradient).

hero.design: Dark navy/space tech background. Use 'hero_bg_particles' as absolute bg overlay. Grid lines, subtle particles, soft gradient orbs.
hero.elements: Badge overline, H1 Title ('Şirketinizi Dijitalde Roketliyoruz'), Subtitle, Primary CTA, Secondary CTA. Floating 'dashboard_mockup' image on the right or bottom center.

positioning_cards.design: 3-card section overlapping the hero bottom or directly below it on a soft gray background.
positioning_cards.elements: Trust-building metrics or core value pillars. White cards, subtle border, hover lift.

dr_ai_system.elements: Connecting lines, glowing active state dots, perhaps utilizing the 'ai_workflow_nodes' image alongside the steps.

corporate_solutions.elements: Modern icons, short titles, brief descriptions, 'Learn more' link. Pure white cards on #F8FAFC background.

sprint_timeline.design: Vertical or horizontal timeline activated on scroll.
sprint_timeline.elements: Milestone markers, success green (#10B981) for completed/active states.

case_studies.design: 4 cards detailing Need / Solution / Result structure.
case_studies.elements: Corporate business team images, metric highlights (e.g., '300% efficiency').

roket_partner.elements: Grid of sponsor/partner logos (black and white transparent style).

blog_teasers.elements: Image, date, title, read more button.

final_cta.design: Premium dark gradient section using 'cta_dark_gradient' background.
final_cta.elements: Strong headline, Gradient CTA button, Trust signals.

footer.design: Premium footer with 4 columns. bg-[#020617] with white/slate text.

interactions_and_motion.hero: Title fade-up on load. Dashboard mockups floating smoothly (infinite y-axis sine wave). Background orbs have subtle slow movement.
interactions_and_motion.cards: Stagger fade-up on scroll. On hover: cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1 or 2), border becomes slightly stronger/colorful (e.g., border-electric_cyan/30), shadow deepens.
interactions_and_motion.buttons: Gradient CTA buttons have a subtle glow that expands on hover. Scale up slightly (scale-105).
interactions_and_motion.timeline: Lines and dots light up (activate) sequentially as the user scrolls down.
interactions_and_motion.restrictions: Professional and controlled only. NO over-animation. NO bouncy or game-like effects. Keep it serious and corporate. Mobile must have simplified animations.

hero_bg_particles.description: Abstract dark space tech background with subtle glowing grid lines, perfect for hero section overlay.
hero_bg_particles.usage: Background image for the Hero section, set to cover with low opacity.

dashboard_mockup.description: Premium modern B2B SaaS admin dashboard mockup.
dashboard_mockup.usage: Floating main visual in the Hero section.

ai_workflow_nodes.description: Abstract 3D glowing nodes and connected networks.
ai_workflow_nodes.usage: Visual for DR AI System or About section.

cta_dark_gradient.description: Premium dark gradient background blending purple and navy.
cta_dark_gradient.usage: Background for the Final CTA section.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup fonts: Import Manrope and Inter via Google Fonts. Ensure they are configured in tailwind.config.js.
2. Setup colors: Extend Tailwind theme with the explicit hex codes provided in the colors section.
3. Install UI dependencies: Install @phosphor-icons/react, framer-motion (for controlled animations), and any required shadcn components (cards, forms, inputs, tabs).
4. Use semantic HTML and apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
5. For the hero, layer the deep_space_navy background, then the hero_bg_particles image with low opacity, and place the floating dashboard mockup in a prominent position.
6. Adhere strictly to the Turkish language content requested.
7. DO NOT use generic or cheap aesthetics. The padding must be generous, text contrast must meet accessibility standards, and components must feel like a multi-million dollar SaaS platform.
